pages.title: A silver herb
lines: A silver herb arrives.
pages.translation: 一枝銀色藥草來了。

pages.title: A leafy doorway
lines: The leaves open a door.
pages.translation: 葉片打開一扇門。

pages.title: Mira on the roof
lines: Mira lands safely.
pages.translation: 米拉安全落地。

pages.title: A lantern lesson
lines: The potion lights lamps.
pages.translation: 靈藥會點亮燈。

pages.title: Three ingredients
lines: They need three things.
pages.translation: 她們需要三樣材料。

pages.title: Silver veins

pages.translation: 瑜瑜看著葉子。

pages.title: The marked path
lines: They follow the path.
pages.translation: 她們沿著小路走。

pages.title: Check again
lines: Gail does not pick it.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜沒有摘它。

pages.title: One moonmint leaf
lines: The teacher says yes.
pages.translation: 老師說找對了。

pages.title: A cool mist
lines: Mist covers the signs.
pages.translation: 霧遮住了標記。

pages.title: One low hover
lines: Mira flies low.
pages.translation: 米拉低低飛起。

pages.title: The blue leaf
lines: The leaf smells sweet.
pages.translation: 葉子聞起來香香的。

pages.title: A dew crystal
lines: Gail catches one drop.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜接住一滴露珠。

pages.title: Check the recipe
lines: They check the order.
pages.translation: 她們核對順序。

pages.title: Mortar and pestle

pages.translation: 米拉壓碎葉子。

pages.title: A cloudy sample
lines: The first vial is cloudy.
pages.translation: 第一瓶變混濁了。

pages.title: Find the missing step
lines: They find a missing leaf.
pages.translation: 她們找到漏掉的葉子。

pages.title: A bright new potion
lines: The new potion glows.
pages.translation: 新靈藥發亮了。

pages.title: Lanterns on the path
lines: The path lights up.
pages.translation: 小路亮起來了。

pages.title: Back in her room
lines: Gail checks what changed.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜記得檢查變化。

pages.title: A silver herb
lines: A silver herb and a note arrive from Mira.
pages.translation: 米拉送來銀色藥草和字條。

pages.title: A leafy doorway
lines: The moonmint opens. Leaf lights make a doorway to school.
pages.translation: 月薄荷展開，葉形光點打開校門。

pages.title: Mira on the roof
lines: Mira lands low and welcomes Gail at the academy.
pages.translation: 米拉在學校低空落地，迎接瑜瑜。

pages.title: A lantern lesson
lines: The teacher says their potion will light the path, not be drunk.
pages.translation: 老師說靈藥用來點亮小路，不可以喝。

pages.title: Three ingredients
lines: The guide shows two leaves and one dew crystal.
pages.translation: 圖鑑畫著兩片葉和一顆露晶。

pages.title: Silver veins
lines: Gail compares the leaves and finds silver moon shapes.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜比較葉片，找到銀色月牙紋。

pages.title: The marked path
lines: The friends follow a marked path with the teacher nearby.
pages.translation: 老師在附近，朋友們沿標記小路走。

pages.title: Check again
lines: Gail checks a look-alike leaf and asks the teacher first.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜再次核對相似葉片，先問老師。

pages.title: One moonmint leaf
lines: After the teacher checks, Gail takes one moonmint leaf.
pages.translation: 老師確認後，瑜瑜取下一片月薄荷。

pages.title: A cool mist
lines: Cool mist hides the signs, so everyone stays together.
pages.translation: 涼霧遮住路標，大家仍一起走。

pages.title: One low hover
lines: Mira hovers low, finds blue sage, and lands safely.
pages.translation: 米拉低飛找到藍鼠尾草，安全落地。

pages.title: The blue leaf
lines: The teacher checks blue sage by its tip and sweet smell.
pages.translation: 老師看藍色葉尖，也聞一聞香氣。

pages.title: A dew crystal
lines: Gail catches a dew crystal by the covered fountain.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜在有遮棚的噴泉旁接住露晶。

pages.title: Check the recipe
lines: Gail and Mira agree on the recipe before they mix.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜和米拉調製前先核對配方。

pages.title: Mortar and pestle
lines: Mira crushes the leaf, and Gail adds measured dew.
pages.translation: 米拉壓碎葉子，瑜瑜加入量好的露珠。

pages.title: A cloudy sample
lines: A bubble rises, but the first mixture turns cloudy.
pages.translation: 泡泡冒出，第一瓶混合液卻變混濁。

pages.title: Find the missing step
lines: Gail finds the missing blue sage step in the recipe.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜在配方中找到漏掉的藍鼠尾草。

pages.title: A bright new potion
lines: They measure again. The new potion shines blue.
pages.translation: 她們重新測量，新靈藥發出藍光。

pages.title: Lanterns on the path
lines: The teacher fills covered lanterns, and the path glows.
pages.translation: 老師裝好有罩燈籠，小路亮起來了。

pages.title: Back in her room
lines: Gail remembers to identify, measure, and check together.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜記得一起辨認、測量、檢查變化。

pages.title: A silver herb
lines: Beside Mira's old broom charm and the magic ball, a silver moonmint herb arrives with a note from her academy. Its leaves are still folded.
pages.translation: 在米拉留下的掃帚吊飾與魔法球旁，一枝銀色月薄荷和魔法學校的字條來了。葉片還合著。

pages.title: A leafy doorway
lines: The moonmint opens one leaf, then another. Leaf-shaped lights rise from it and form a doorway to the familiar school roof.
pages.translation: 月薄荷先展開一片葉，再展開另一片。葉形光點從它身上升起，打開通往熟悉校舍屋頂的門。

pages.title: Mira on the roof
lines: Mira is a student at the academy. She welcomes Gail after a careful low landing. Their teacher invites both friends into the potion classroom beside the roof.
pages.translation: 米拉是魔法學校的學生。她小心完成低空落地後迎接瑜瑜，老師請兩位朋友進入屋頂旁的靈藥教室。

pages.title: A lantern lesson
lines: Today's recipe will make a potion for the greenhouse path lanterns. The teacher explains that this brew is for lights, not for drinking.
pages.translation: 今天的配方要做一瓶點亮溫室小路燈籠的靈藥。老師說明，這瓶藥水只供燈籠使用，不拿來喝。

pages.title: Three ingredients
lines: They need three ingredients: one moonmint leaf, one blue sage leaf, and a crystal of dew. The teacher gives them a picture guide and three small vials.
pages.translation: 她們需要三種材料：一片月薄荷葉、一片藍鼠尾草葉和一顆露晶。老師給她們圖鑑與三個小瓶。

pages.title: Silver veins
lines: Gail compares the moonmint drawing with a similar green herb. The silver crescent veins tell her which plant to leave untouched.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜比較圖鑑上的月薄荷與旁邊相似的綠葉藥草。銀色月牙形葉脈幫她辨認，也讓她不去碰不確定的植物。

pages.title: The marked path
lines: Mira and Gail follow the marked garden path with their teacher nearby. They look beneath a shaded arch where moonmint grows.
pages.translation: 米拉與瑜瑜沿著有記號的園路走，老師就在附近。她們到陰涼拱門下找月薄荷。

pages.title: Check again
lines: A look-alike leaf points the wrong way, but Gail does not pick it. She checks the silver veins again before asking the teacher.
pages.translation: 一片相似的葉子讓人差點認錯，瑜瑜沒有摘下它。她再次核對銀色葉脈，然後請老師確認。

pages.title: One moonmint leaf
lines: The teacher confirms the moonmint. Gail takes one leaf from the planted herb and places it safely in the first vial.
pages.translation: 老師確認找到了月薄荷。瑜瑜從栽種區取下一片葉，妥善放進第一個小瓶。

pages.title: A cool mist
lines: A cool mist drifts across the path and softens the painted signs. Everyone stays together while they look for the blue sage patch.
pages.translation: 一陣涼霧飄過園路，讓彩繪標記變得模糊。大家結伴找藍鼠尾草，不各自走散。

pages.title: One low hover
lines: With the teacher watching, Mira makes one low hover above the path. She spots a blue-tipped leaf beyond the next bend and lands before pointing it out.
pages.translation: 老師看顧下，米拉沿路低低懸停一次。她看見轉彎後的藍尖葉，先安全落地，再指給大家看。

pages.title: The blue leaf
lines: The teacher identifies the blue sage. When she gently crushes a sample leaf, its sweet aroma matches the picture guide's clue.
pages.translation: 老師辨認出藍鼠尾草。她輕輕捻開一片樣本葉，柔和香氣也符合圖鑑線索。

pages.title: A dew crystal
lines: At a covered fountain, a dew crystal hangs above the water. Gail catches one droplet in the third vial without reaching over the edge.
pages.translation: 在有遮棚的噴泉旁，一顆露晶懸在水面上。瑜瑜站在安全處，讓一滴露珠落入第三個小瓶。

pages.title: Check the recipe
lines: Back in class, the teacher sets a small cauldron beside the recipe cards. Remembering their ball game, Gail and Mira agree on the order and measure each ingredient before they brew.
pages.translation: 回到教室，老師把小坩堝放在配方卡旁。想起上次魔法球的遊戲，瑜瑜與米拉先說好順序、量好每份材料，才開始調製。

pages.title: Mortar and pestle
lines: Mira uses a mortar and pestle to crush the moonmint leaf. Gail adds the measured dew while the teacher checks the order.
pages.translation: 米拉用研缽與杵把月薄荷葉輕輕壓碎。瑜瑜加入量好的露珠，老師在旁核對順序。

pages.title: A cloudy sample
lines: The teacher adds warm water so the crystal can dissolve. One little bubble rises, but the first mixture turns cloudy instead of bright.
pages.translation: 老師加入溫水，讓露晶溶解。一顆小泡泡冒起，第一瓶混合液卻變得混濁，沒有發亮。

pages.title: Find the missing step
lines: Gail compares this small sample with the recipe. They find the missing blue sage step. It is smart to check before trying again, so they begin a fresh vial rather than guessing at the cloudy one.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜拿這一小瓶樣本對照配方，發現漏了藍鼠尾草那一步。再試之前先檢查，是聰明的做法；她們重新用一個小瓶調製，沒有對混濁的那瓶亂加材料。

pages.title: A bright new potion
lines: This time they add each part in order and measure the dew again. The new potion begins to shimmer with a gentle blue light.
pages.translation: 這次她們按順序加入材料，也重新量好露珠。新靈藥開始閃著柔和藍光。

pages.title: Lanterns on the path
lines: The teacher pours the finished potion into covered lanterns. Light travels along the greenhouse path, and Mira and Gail can see where every turn leads.
pages.translation: 老師把完成的靈藥倒入有罩的燈籠。光沿溫室小路延伸，米拉與瑜瑜看得清每個轉彎。

pages.title: Back in her room
lines: Back in her bedroom, Gail sets the folded moonmint beside Mira's broom charm and magic ball. She remembers to identify, measure, and check a change together.
pages.translation: 回到房間，瑜瑜把收攏的月薄荷放在米拉的掃帚吊飾和魔法球旁。她記得一起辨認、測量，再檢查變化。

chinese: 在米拉留下的掃帚吊飾與魔法球旁，一枝銀色月薄荷和魔法學校的字條來了。葉片還合著。
月薄荷先展開一片葉，再展開另一片。葉形光點從它身上升起，打開通往熟悉校舍屋頂的門。
米拉是魔法學校的學生。她小心完成低空落地後迎接瑜瑜，老師請兩位朋友進入屋頂旁的靈藥教室。
今天的配方要做一瓶點亮溫室小路燈籠的靈藥。老師說明，這瓶藥水只供燈籠使用，不拿來喝。
她們需要三種材料：一片月薄荷葉、一片藍鼠尾草葉和一顆露晶。老師給她們圖鑑與三個小瓶。
瑜瑜比較圖鑑上的月薄荷與旁邊相似的綠葉藥草。銀色月牙形葉脈幫她辨認，也讓她不去碰不確定的植物。
米拉與瑜瑜沿著有記號的園路走，老師就在附近。她們到陰涼拱門下找月薄荷。
一片相似的葉子讓人差點認錯，瑜瑜沒有摘下它。她再次核對銀色葉脈，然後請老師確認。
老師確認找到了月薄荷。瑜瑜從栽種區取下一片葉，妥善放進第一個小瓶。
一陣涼霧飄過園路，讓彩繪標記變得模糊。大家結伴找藍鼠尾草，不各自走散。
老師看顧下，米拉沿路低低懸停一次。她看見轉彎後的藍尖葉，先安全落地，再指給大家看。
老師辨認出藍鼠尾草。她輕輕捻開一片樣本葉，柔和香氣也符合圖鑑線索。
在有遮棚的噴泉旁，一顆露晶懸在水面上。瑜瑜站在安全處，讓一滴露珠落入第三個小瓶。
回到教室，老師把小坩堝放在配方卡旁。想起上次魔法球的遊戲，瑜瑜與米拉先說好順序、量好每份材料，才開始調製。
米拉用研缽與杵把月薄荷葉輕輕壓碎。瑜瑜加入量好的露珠，老師在旁核對順序。
老師加入溫水，讓露晶溶解。一顆小泡泡冒起，第一瓶混合液卻變得混濁，沒有發亮。
瑜瑜拿這一小瓶樣本對照配方，發現漏了藍鼠尾草那一步。再試之前先檢查，是聰明的做法；她們重新用一個小瓶調製，沒有對混濁的那瓶亂加材料。
這次她們按順序加入材料，也重新量好露珠。新靈藥開始閃著柔和藍光。
老師把完成的靈藥倒入有罩的燈籠。光沿溫室小路延伸，米拉與瑜瑜看得清每個轉彎。
回到房間，瑜瑜把收攏的月薄荷放在米拉的掃帚吊飾和魔法球旁。她記得一起辨認、測量，再檢查變化。
